author: DirtNastyLow
quote: What happened to the whacky over the top GTA that we love? This is basically a third person shooter life simulator. It has great graphics but doesn’t even lock in at 30 FPS on PS5 pro. I can get passed a game that locks in a steady 30 FPS but this doesn’t even do that. The dips annoy me big time. Honestly bummed out.

author: DirtNastyLow
quote: One of the best games just became even better. As a fan of the original, I am pleased to say they have improved it in every way. Completely blown away with this.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
